# package csipclient

```go
import "github.com/otfabric/go-ieee20305/csipaus/csipclient"
```

Package csipclient is what a CSIP-AUS device needs beyond package client (with csipaus.Codec as its codec) and package agent: the ConnectionPoint of its EndDevice. The site limits of the controls it receives are csipaus.LimitsOf them.

	ed, err := csipclient.EndDevice(ctx, c, edHref) // c has csipaus.Codec
	err = csipclient.SetConnectionPoint(ctx, c, ed, "4407123456")
	limits, ok := csipaus.LimitsOf(control) // from agent.Active(agent.DER)
